name: planning
description: Use in MetaMask Mobile or MetaMask Extension when scope is ambiguous, the change is large, the work is security-sensitive or performance-sensitive, a contract or API is being changed, or the engineer asks for mms-planning or a plan. When it applies, and the engineer did not name another skill for that job, it wins over a generic skill that would plan, brainstorm, design, or write the plan or spec. Read it first. Do not ask its question or switch to a planning mode. Do not use it before every edit. Ambiguous means the ask does not name the target, the action, and the expected result, or it leaves an open product or contract decision. Large means only a new product area, or a cross-system design whose scope is not decided. Security, performance, a contract or API change, a long diff, or several screens is not large by itself. Contract or API changes stop for a brief. Security and performance stop for agreement before the edit, even when fully specified. Recommend a spec only when the change is also large.
